papers.title: Spatial-Interactor: Learning Spatial Reasoning through Interaction with the Observable Physical World
papers.desc: Spatial reasoning is essential for vision-language models (VLMs) to understand and act in the physical world.

papers.title: GeoPair: Geometry-Preserving Cross-Layer Factorization for Training-Free Transformer Compression
papers.desc: Transformer architectures exhibit cross-layer redundancies, yet post-training compression pipelines typically optimize layers in isolation or rely on heuristic grouping strategies that disregard layer-specific activation geometries.

papers.title: PackLab: A Comprehensive Framework for Developing, Training, and Evaluating MLLMs in Robotic Bin Packing
papers.desc: Robotic bin packing requires long-horizon sequential decision-making, as each object placement affects the available space for subsequent packing.

papers.title: All modalities are equal, but video is more equal: Closing the Cross-Attention Gap in Joint Video Generation
papers.desc: Video is a rich representation of a physical event, capturing appearance, geometry, motion, and temporal evolution.

papers.title: On the Diffusibility of High-Dimensional Latents
papers.desc: Representation Autoencoders (RAEs) enable diffusion models to operate in the feature spaces of pretrained visual encoders.

papers.title: Capable yet Parsimonious: Extracting and Characterizing Hidden Chain-of-Thought in Frontier Models
papers.desc: The rapid capability gains of frontier language models are widely attributed to improved reasoning abilities, yet this cannot be verified as raw CoT traces in closed-source systems are hidden.

papers.title: Calibration as a First-Class Criterion in LLM Evaluation
papers.desc: Calibration of language models -- the alignment between expressed or implicit confidence and empirical correctness -- is a well-studied subfield within NLP.

papers.title: FLEET: From Logits Entropy to Enhanced Trajectories in Text Generation
papers.desc: Solutions based on large language models (LLMs) often rely on temperature sampling to improve accuracy and stability by aggregating multiple samples from the completion distribution.

papers.title: Six Layers Less: Encoder Pruning for Whisper with Label-Free Recovery
papers.desc: Pruning large pre-trained transformer-based ASR models such as OpenAI's Whisper has seen great adoption, as pruning the decoder led to significant end-to-end transcription speedups.

papers.title: Self-Organizing Agent Teams Learn to Reason Together
papers.desc: Collective intelligence depends not only on what team members know, but also on how they organize their work.

papers.title: The Linear Representation Hypothesis Needs a Group Action
papers.desc: To make claims about representations that generalize beyond a particular trained model, we need to specify when two representations should count as equivalent.

papers.title: Knowledge Pull Requests for Continual Document Authoring
papers.desc: We introduce Knowledge Pull Requests (KPRs), a framework for continual document authoring that makes each change interpretable.

papers.title: X-Planner: Event-Structured Task Planning for Embodied Intelligence
papers.desc: Task planning bridges high-level instructions and executable behavior in long-horizon manipulation, yet modern Vision-Language-Action (VLA) systems often leave this intermediate structure implicit.

papers.title: Uranus: Building the Next-Generation Simulation Infrastructure for Embodied AI
papers.desc: Scalable simulation is essential for robot data generation, policy training, evaluation, and safe iteration, yet real-world interaction is costly and conventional simulators require labor-intensive construction.

papers.title: MemoryAthena: Adaptive Routing over Latent and Generated Memories
papers.desc: Learned-memory methods store information in an explicit table and consume it through a separate reader, allowing addressing, storage, and reading to be modified independently.
